svg.title: The lifecycle of a supervisor-harness run
svg.desc: created, analyzing, synthesizing, awaiting_approval, executing, verifying, checkpoint (not passed: back to executing), awaiting_owner while an escalation is open, improving, complete; report mode goes from synthesizing to improving; failed is reachable from any phase.

text.tspan: Every arrow is a PHASE_CHANGED event on the run's log, so a run resumes at whatever phase it reached.
an open escalation waits for you
not passed: reopen the tasks that fell short, with the checkpoint's corrections
report mode, or no tasks proposed
